dismissed.title: Benchmark contamination: Claude appears to have memorized details of the LinuxArena control eval ( Karvonen ).
dismissed.reason: The newsletter only mentions a claimed LinuxArena contamination finding in one sentence. It gives no audit method, benchmark evidence, or quoted source details.

dismissed.title: GauntletScore: Auditable Fact-Checking That Matches the Best Published Checkers on LLM-AggreFact
dismissed.reason: The paper evaluates a new fact-checking engine on LLM-AggreFact. It does not report a concrete defect in the LLM-AggreFact benchmark or its labels or grader.

dismissed.title: Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models
dismissed.reason: The paper uses HANS and other datasets to audit System 1 models. It does not report a concrete problem with the cataloged HANS benchmark itself.

dismissed.title: Construct Validity of Coding Benchmarks for LLM-based Agentic Coding Tools
dismissed.reason: The paper maps claimed constructs, metrics and possible confounders across nine coding benchmarks. It reports no concrete defect in the cataloged Anthropic internal evaluation.
